items.prompt: Which shows the position of the first child in line?
items.explanation: 1st names the first position in line. A count of 8 children, a height, or a length does not name a position.

items.prompt: Which shows the position right after first?
items.explanation: 2nd (second) comes right after 1st (first) in a line.

items.prompt: Which shows the position of the tenth child in line?
items.explanation: 10th names the tenth position in line. '10 children' is a count, not a position.

items.prompt: Which shows the position of the 100th runner in a race?
items.explanation: 100th names the one-hundredth position. It is about order in a line, not a count of 100 things.
1st is an ordinal number: it names a position, first in line.
